subject: AWS product page: usage scenarios, SKU guidance, and co-sell checklist
messages:
From: Emma Chen <emma@acme-analytics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: quick review of our draft AWS product page + co-sell ask

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the intro last week. We prepared a draft product page for Acme Analytics' "SearchSense for logs" offering and a short usage matrix (attached). We're aiming to publish next week; can your marketplace team give a quick review on the copy and confirm any co-sell entitlements we should request from AWS?

Two specific asks:
- Are the usage scenarios clear to a field rep (3 short examples in the one-pager)?
- Any red flags on the technical claims/AMI language that would block listing?

I've attached the one-pager and a usage matrix. Happy to hop on a 20m call if that's easier.

Thanks,
Emma Chen
Head of Alliances, Acme Analytics
emma@acme-analytics.com
+1 (415) 555-0134

Attachments:
- acme-product-one-pager.pdf (1.1MB)
- sample-usage-matrix.xlsx (45KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Emma Chen <emma@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: quick review of our draft AWS product page + co-sell ask

Hi Emma — thanks for sending these over and for the quick turnaround.

I'll loop in Marissa (go-to-market copy) for product page voice and Jonas (partner ops/AMI) for the technical bits. High-level read-through below; Marissa/Jonas, please add inline notes or propose direct edits.

Preliminary notes:
- Usage scenarios: the three examples are useful, but they read a bit product-heavy. Suggest we lead with the customer outcome ("faster incident resolution by X%") then show the technical trigger. Field reps prefer the problem → impact → how we solve framing.
- CTA: add a clear trial CTA ("Start a 14-day trial via AWS Marketplace") and a short bullet on billing (metered vs. subscription) so procurement sees it quickly.
- Technical claims: avoid absolute numbers unless backed by a benchmark link; Jonas, can you confirm whether the "real-time" claim is supported for 100k events/sec on t4g instances?

Emma — would you be open to a 20-min sync tomorrow at 9am PT? If so I'll send a calendar invite.

Cheers,
Kimberly Park
Senior Product Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Emma Chen <emma@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: quick review of our draft AWS product page + co-sell ask

Thanks Kim & Emma — quick copy pass below (high level), happy to follow up with a tracked-changes doc.

Headline suggestion:
- Current: "SearchSense for logs — fast, accurate log search"
- Suggestion: "Reduce MTTR with instant, cost-aware log search"

Lead paragraph: focus on customer pain (slow search during incidents) and a short outcome metric. Keep one sentence on how: "deployed via AWS Marketplace with consumption-based billing."

Usage scenarios: reframe to three two-line field bullets — problem, customer, outcome. Example: "Ops team at SaaS Co needs to Triage JVM OOMs faster → SearchSense reduces query time from minutes to seconds, slashing MTTR by up to 3x (example customer)."

Bullet copy checklist for listing:
- Clear trial CTA and link to private offer if required
- Short pricing descriptor: metered by query units / subscription tiers (include example $/100k queries)
- Evidence snippets (1-line) + link to case study (Drive link)
- Remove unsupported absolute latency numbers unless benchmarked

I'll prepare a tracked-changes version and drop it into the Drive folder in the next hour.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole, Product Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Emma Chen <emma@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: quick review of our draft AWS product page + co-sell ask

Emma — quick technical notes from partner-ops perspective:
- AMI / deployment language: If you're offering an AMI image, call out AMI ID placeholders and that the AMI will be validated by AWS during listing. Do not publish a beta AMI ID; use "AMI pending validation" until final.
- Claims: "real-time at 100k events/sec" is tricky — on m5.large equivalents with our runtime you'll need different instance sizing; recommend we rephrase to "supports high-throughput streaming workload with configurable instance sizing (see usage matrix)."
- SKU/entitlement: If you want co-sell, request "private offers" + "qualified listing" and ensure the SKU maps to a product code for usage-based metering. I'll attach an example SKU mapping in Drive.
- Docs/AWS evidence: include a short operations checklist (start/stop, snapshot, backup) — AWS review will look for operational notes.

On process: I'll raise a quick internal ticket to request AWS listing review once Kimberly confirms final copy and the AMI note is nominal.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber, Partner Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Emma Chen <emma@acme-analytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: AWS Marketplace PM <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 15:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: quick review of our draft AWS product page + co-sell ask

Emma — thanks for the quick updates. Attachments look good. A few final action items before we hand to AWS: 

Action items (owner) — target: publish next week
- Emma: replace the absolute throughput number with the phrasing Jonas suggested and upload a non-beta AMI placeholder (if publishing an AMI) — due EOD Mon 3/8.
- Marissa: finalize hero headline and add the trial CTA + 2-line pricing descriptor — due Mon 3/8.
- Jonas: confirm SKU mapping and open the listing review ticket with AWS once we have final copy — I'll need the SKU by Tue 3/9.
- Kimberly: I'll draft the short co-sell justification paragraph (how Redwood & Acme will engage field teams) and share with AWS PM for eligibility review.

Emma — I'm copying the AWS Marketplace PM to flag that we plan to submit the listing and request guidance on co-sell entitlements (private offer + field enablement). AWS — can you confirm the best contact for the co-sell intake and expected SLA for a listing review?

If everyone is aligned I won't schedule a call; we can run updates asynchronously.

Thanks all — looking forward to launch.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Product Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
